match_policy.exact: Diacritic-, honorific- and punctuation-insensitive FULL NAME equality only; matching names is not sufficient to certify a human person or group.
match_policy.ambiguity: If more than one existing key has the same full name, retain every candidate and do not choose one.
match_policy.place: All sites must exist in the original geography seed and have sourced coordinates. A shrine association does not establish birth, residence, death, apparition or relic authenticity.
match_policy.no_auto_publication: All new candidate associations remain non-public until owner confirms exact person identity and site relation. No duplicate map pin.
match_policy.art: No artwork ID, previous user rating or licensing state is changed.
